desc:
🌊 DON'T SPLASH! Barry's prison is FLOODED and Monster Barry lives in the water! 🌊

Jump from pad to pad to escape the prison. Your feet touch the water? SPLASH… Monster Barry comes out of the water and catches you! 😱 Stay on the wooden pads and he can't get you!

🏃 HOW TO PLAY
• Jump across the pads – don't touch the water!
• Sneak past Policeman Barry and Monster Policeman 2
• Grab the food bazooka and beat the Monster Chef!
• Reach the end and ESCAPE the prison!

⭐ FEATURES
• Easy & Hard mode + time leaderboards
• 🎁 FREE Monster Barry morph – Like & Favorite the game!
• 👮 Become a VIP Guard: Barry, Grumpy Gran, Mr Funny Dummy, Ani-Tron, Siren Cop & Papa Pizza – chase your friends!
• 🛒 Shop: Jetpack, Grapple Gun, Speed Coil, Rocket Launcher, Laser Gun & more
• First person or third person – your choice 👁️
• Works great on phone, tablet and PC

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
